name: Algebraic Isomorphism Mapping (AIM)
description: This method translates graph-theoretic concepts (nodes, edges, trees, connected components) into their exact abstract algebraic equivalents (set elements, generating pairs, minimal generating sets, equivalence classes). By removing spatial/network vocabulary and using "equivalence relation", it bypasses LLM heuristics that trigger tree-pruning templates, and instead baits them into applying DSU/Kruskal's algorithm (which fails to prune useless cheap branches on this specific problem).
